sonuc.drug_name: Ibuprofen Gen.Orph 5 mg/mL solution for injection

what_for.text: It helps close an open blood vessel near the baby's heart.
what_for.evidence: Ibuprofen Gen.Orph, when given to your baby, can help to close the ductus arteriosus.

how_to_use.text: Given only in intensive care by healthcare professionals.
how_to_use.evidence: Ibuprofen Gen.Orph will only be given to your baby in a special neonatal intensive care unit by qualified health care professionals.

how_to_use.text: A treatment course is three injections given 24 hours apart.
how_to_use.evidence: A course of therapy is defined as three intravenous injections of Ibuprofen Gen.Orph given at 24 hour intervals.

how_to_use.text: The medicine is infused into a vein over 15 minutes.
how_to_use.evidence: This calculated amount will be given by infusion in a vein over a period of 15 minutes.

see_doctor_now.text: Stop treatment at once if a skin rash or blisters appear.
see_doctor_now.evidence: Your doctor should discontinue Ibuprofen Gen.Orph immediately, if any of the following side effects occur: skin rash, lesions of the mucous membranes, blisters or other signs of allergy

see_doctor_now.text: Stop treatment immediately if rash, fever, or swollen lymph nodes occur.
see_doctor_now.evidence: Your doctor should discontinue Ibuprofen Gen.Orph immediately, if any of the following side effects occur: skin rash, fever, swelling of lymph nodes and an increase of eosinophils

side_effects.text: Very common side effects include low blood platelets and reduced white blood cells.
side_effects.evidence: Very common (may affect more than 1 in 10 people) ... Decrease in the number of platelets in the blood (thrombocytopenia), ... Decrease in white blood cells called neutrophils (neutropenia)

side_effects.text: Common side effects include bleeding inside the skull or lungs.
side_effects.evidence: Common (may affect up to 1 in 10 people) ... Bleeding inside the skull (intraventricular haemorrhage) and brain injury (periventricular leukomalacia), ... Bleeding in the lung

side_effects.text: Common side effects include reduced urine volume and fluid retention.
side_effects.evidence: Common (may affect up to 1 in 10 people) ... Reduced volume of urine passed, blood in the urine, fluid retention.

storage.text: Keep out of the sight and reach of children.
storage.evidence: Keep this medicine out of the sight and reach of children.
After opening, Ibuprofen Gen.Orph should be administered immediately.

storage.text: Do not use if the solution shows visible deterioration.
storage.evidence: Do not use this medicine if you notice visible signs of deterioration of the solution.
